component.name: Legilo
component.summary: Read selected text, the clipboard or documents aloud

description.p: Legilo reads text aloud with natural-sounding neural voices that run entirely on your computer. Select text in any application and press a shortcut to hear it, or have it read the clipboard or a plain-text file.
Text copied from PDF files is cleaned up before it is spoken: lines are joined back into sentences, words broken across lines are mended, and page numbers and running headers are left out.
Legilo works offline and sends nothing anywhere. Its global shortcuts can be changed in System Settings.
